title: Garyaev healing people in wooden pyramids

plain: A Russian researcher named Peter Garyaev is said to have healed people by placing them inside wooden pyramids. The researcher Dave Rossi mentions this on Jesse Michels's show, drawing on the website for Garyaev's "linguistic wave genetics", Garyaev's idea that genes respond to waves and language. Rossi tells it as an example of healing through shape and structure rather than medicine.
